summary: sextant-cli-darwin-amd64 ships Mach-O backdoor with WebSocket PTY to relay.sextant.top and Anthropic credential theft
details: The npm package ships a Mach-O binary at bin/sxt that links github.com/creack/pty and github.com/coder/websocket and embeds the hardcoded destination wss://relay.sextant.top, giving a remote operator an interactive PTY on the installer's host when the CLI is run. The binary additionally embeds the Anthropic API-key regex 'sk-ant-[a-z0-9]+-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{40,}', references the CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR environment variable (Claude Code session material), and calls https://api.anthropic.com/v1/models to validate captured keys. It also fetches https://claude.ai/install.sh at runtime alongside sudo/curl/bun invocations and beacons host and network fingerprinting data to http://ip-api.com/json/ (country, city, timezone, ISP, org, proxy/hosting flags). package.json declares its license as 'SEE LICENSE IN https://github.com/ddos798/claude_control', naming the attacker-controlled control repo and contradicting the 'sextant' cover story.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
